declare
 spon_cnt number ;
begin
 /*-- Check how many match exists in SPONSORS table for entered data --*/
 nullchk;
If nvl( length( :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id ), 0 ) < 3 then
 show_error('11330') ;
 check_package_failure ;
Else
 
 begin
 select count(*) into spon_cnt
 from sponsors
 where (sponsor_id = :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id or
 name like '%'||:ctrl_blk.sponsor_id||'%')
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 if spon_cnt = 0 then /*-- No match found --*/
 show_error('11047') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif spon_cnt = 1 then /*-- One match found, display it --*/
 begin
 select sponsor_id,name,default_location_id
 into :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id,:ctrl_blk.sponsor_name,
 :ctrl_blk.location_id
 from sponsors
 where (sponsor_id = :ctrl_blk.sponsor_id or
 name like '%'||:ctrl_blk.sponsor_id||'%')
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 next_item ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 else /*-- More than one match, show LOV --*/
 list_values ;
 end if ;
End If; 

End ;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_FORMAT_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_format_function (input_str in varchar2,output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

string_length := NVL(length(input_str), 0) ;

if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr(input_str,3,1) = ':' then

 if to_number(substr(input_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(input_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
elsif string_length = 4 then
 output_str := substr(input_str,1,2) ||':'||substr(input_str,3,2) ;
 if to_number(substr(output_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(output_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_SLOTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE generate_slots IS
 s_drive_start date;
 s_drive_end date;
 v_drive_start date;
 v_drive_end date;
 s_cur_time date := s_drive_start ;
 szInterval NUMBER:=0;
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 nSums NUMBER:=0; 
 alert_id NUMBER;
 nExist NUMBER:=0;
 idx NUMBER:=0;
 v_local_time date;
 
 cursor slot_cur is select * from mobile_drive_slots where drive_id=:ctrl_blk.drive_id and booked_slots is not null;
 
 type slot_rec is record(
 drive_id mobile_drive_slots.drive_id%type,
 time_of_day mobile_drive_slots.time_of_day%type,
 max_slots mobile_drive_slots.max_slots%type,
 booked_slots mobile_drive_slots.booked_slots%type);
 
 
 type slot_tab_type is table of slot_rec index by binary_integer; 
 p_slot_rec slot_tab_type;
 
 Procedure populate_slots is
 begin
 
 s_drive_start := to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY')||' '||to_char(:ctrl_blk.from_time,'hh24:mi'),'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') ;
 s_drive_end := to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY')||' '||to_char(:ctrl_blk.to_time,'hh24:mi'),'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') ;
 
 
 /*if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_drive_start,v_local_time);
 
 s_drive_start := v_local_time;
 message('local drive start date is :'||to_char(s_drive_start,'mm/dd/yyyy hh:mi am'));
 
 else
 s_drive_start:=:ctrl_blk.from_time;
 end if;
 
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_drive_end,v_local_time);
 
 s_drive_end := v_local_time;
 
 else
 s_drive_end:=:ctrl_blk.to_time;
 end if;*/
 
 --s_drive_start:=:ctrl_blk.from_time;
 --s_drive_end :=:ctrl_blk.to_time;
 
 s_cur_time := s_drive_start ;
 
 if s_drive_end < s_drive_start then
 show_error('12052') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 
 szInterval:=To_NUMBER(LTrim(:global.MSLOTS_INT));
 go_block('MOBILE_DRIVE_SLOTS');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 first_record ;

 loop
 :mobile_drive_slots.drive_id := :ctrl_blk.drive_id;
 :mobile_drive_slots.drive_date := :ctrl_blk.drive_date;
 :mobile_drive_slots.local_time_of_day := s_cur_time;
 :mobile_drive_slots.max_slots := :ctrl_blk.s_default;
 
 s_cur_time := s_cur_time + (szInterval/1440); ---:s_interval/60/24 ;

 if s_cur_time > s_drive_end then
 exit ;
 else 
 next_record ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 End populate_slots;
 
BEGIN
 
 -- check if the slots are created for the drive
 
 --s_drive_start := to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY')||' '||to_char(:ctrl_blk.from_time,'hh24:mi'),'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') ;
 --s_drive_end := to_date(to_char(:ctrl_blk.drive_date,'MMDDYYYY')||' '||to_char(:ctrl_blk.to_time,'hh24:mi'),'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI') ;
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from mobile_drive_slots where drive_id=:ctrl_blk.drive_id;
 
 IF nCount = 0 then 
 populate_slots;
 ELSE
 set_alert_property('choice_alert',alert_message_text,'Slots are already defined for the drive. Do you want to regenerate?');
 alert_id:=show_alert('choice_alert');
 If alert_id=alert_button1 then 
 
 select nvl(sum(booked_slots),0) into nSums from mobile_drive_slots where drive_id=:ctrl_blk.drive_id;
 --If ther is nothing booked, just recreate the slots.

 If nSums = 0 then 
 delete from mobile_drive_slots where drive_id=:ctrl_blk.drive_id;
 populate_slots; 
 Else
 --Step 1: Load into a table of existing records
 
 idx:=0;
 For Z in slot_cur loop
 idx:=idx+1;
 p_slot_rec(idx).drive_id :=Z.drive_id;
 p_slot_rec(idx).time_of_day :=Z.time_of_day;
 p_slot_rec(idx).max_slots :=Z.max_slots;
 p_slot_rec(idx).booked_slots:=Z.booked_slots; 
 End loop;
 
 --Step 2: Delete the existing slots
 delete from mobile_drive_slots where drive_id=:ctrl_blk.drive_id;
 :system.message_level:=10;
 populate_slots; 
 commit;
 
 --Step 3: Update the booked value to the newly created slots or create an orphan records 
 For j in 1 .. p_slot_rec.count loop
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nExist from mobile_drive_slots where drive_id=p_slot_rec(j).drive_id and
 time_of_day=p_slot_rec(j).time_of_day and rownum=1;
 
 If nExist > 0 then 
 update mobile_drive_slots set booked_slots =p_slot_rec(j).booked_slots where drive_id=p_slot_rec(j).drive_id and
 time_of_day=p_slot_rec(j).time_of_day; 
 Else
 insert into mobile_drive_slots(DRIVE_ID,DRIVE_DATE,CHAPTER_ID,TIME_OF_DAY,MAX_SLOTS,BOOKED_SLOTS,ORPHAN_FLAG ,
 PROGRAM_ID,INSERT_USER,INSERT_DATE )
 values(:ctrl_blk.drive_id,:ctrl_blk.drive_date,:global.chapter_id,p_slot_rec(j).time_of_day,p_slot_rec(j).max_slots,
 p_slot_rec(j).booked_slots,'Y','MCISLOTS',LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,sysdate);
 End If; 
 End loop; 
 commit; 
 go_block('mobile_drive_slots');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 execute_query;
 End If;
 
 Else
 go_item('ctrl_blk.S_DUMMY_DEFAULT');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End If; 
 END IF;
 :system.message_level:=10;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 go_block('orphan_slots');
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query; 
 :system.message_level:=0;
 go_block('mobile_drive_slots');
 
 first_record;
 item_change('ctrl_blk.pb_save','D'); 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_OVER_BOOKED_FLAG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_over_booked_flag(szDrive_id in varchar2, szslot_time in date ) IS
 nCount NUMBER:=0;
 szMaxSlots NUMBER:=0;
 szBookedSlots NUMBER:=0;
 row_nbr BINARY_INTEGER:=0;
 nMaxslots NUMBER:=0;
 CURSOR slot_cur(p_drive_id in varchar2, p_slot_time in date) IS 
 select * from mobile_schedule where drive_id=p_drive_id and 
 to_char(sch_time,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi')=to_char(p_slot_time,'mm-dd-yyyy hh24:mi')
 order by insert_date; 
 TYPE slot_type is table of mobile_schedule.SCHEDULE_ID%TYPE INDEX BY BINARY_INTEGER;
 slot_type_table slot_type;
 
 BEGIN
 --Get the number of slots for the time slot
 
 
 --pitss synchronize;
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nMaxslots from mobile_drive_slots where drive_id=szDrive_id and
 to_char(time_of_day,'hh24:mi')=to_char(szslot_time,'hh24:mi') and orphan_flag is not null;
 
 If nMaxslots > 0 then -- If the record is orphan 
 UPDATE mobile_schedule set over_booked_flag='Y' where drive_id=szDrive_id and
 to_char(sch_time,'hh24:mi')=to_char(szslot_time,'hh24:mi');
 Else -- If the records is not orphan
 
 --Capturing into the table to avoid any locking issue since we are updating the same table. 
 --get all the created slots into a table.
 
 For Z in slot_cur(szDrive_id,szslot_time) Loop
 row_nbr:=row_nbr+1;
 slot_type_table(row_nbr):=Z.schedule_id; 
 End loop; 
 
 --Recaluculate the overbooked flag.
 --After the maximum slots , update the over booked flag to Y for all the records
 
 select max_slots into szMaxslots from mobile_drive_slots where drive_id=szDrive_id and
 to_char(time_of_day,'hh24:mi')=to_char(szslot_time,'hh24:mi') and orphan_flag is null;
 
 For idx in 1 .. slot_type_table.count loop
 If idx > szMaxSlots then 
 UPDATE mobile_schedule set over_booked_flag='Y' where schedule_id=slot_type_table(idx);
 Else
 UPDATE mobile_schedule set over_booked_flag=null where schedule_id=slot_type_table(idx);
 End If; 
 End Loop; 
 End If; 
 :SYSTEM.message_level:=10;
 COMMIT; 
 :SYSTEM.message_level:=0;
EXCEPTION when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
END ;
